findings.claim: Removing `input: arg1` from the `trpcSubscriptionOptions` call likely drops the user-supplied input from the actual subscription request
findings.rationale: The `input` is only retained inside `getQueryKeyInternal({ ... input: arg1 ... })`, which is used solely to build the cache/query key. Unless `trpcSubscriptionOptions` derives the input from `queryKey` (e.g. `queryKey[0][1].input`), the subscription will be invoked with `undefined` input while still being keyed by the input — producing a silently wrong request (and possibly an input-validation error server-side). This is a behavior change for every existing caller of `subscriptionOptions(input)`. Moderately confident this is a bug; it is only safe if `trpcSubscriptionOptions` was simultaneously changed to read the input out of `queryKey`, and even then the two sources could diverge.
